description: Engine §4: restored forest tags, filtered and unfiltered, keep separate answers, filtered first.

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage before
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $w:word $b:bad
%emits $w :: X, $b :: X
%rule word A
%rule bad A
%error "bad"
%stage last
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $x:pair
%conditions (Clean ⊆ $x.without-elision.parse(word).error-free.tags) ∧ (Dirty ⊈ $x.without-elision.parse(word).error-free.tags) ∧ (Dirty ⊆ $x.without-elision.parse(word).tags)
%rule pair X X
%rule word
  | X X :: Dirty
  | X junk :: Clean
%rule junk X
%erased
```
